scope: three clinician operations (record, confirm, correct) build a P2-i ledger; destination requirement profiles are data; each query asks whether a destination version is satisfied by the ledger at a reference time and target time(s); no UI, LLM, DSL syntax, real master, persistence, billing or clinical judgment
operations: record and correct become a P2-i record plus a P2-f quantity wrapper; confirm becomes a human content-bound review; content hashes are computed by the library; operations never carry hashes
selection: the fixed P2-i plan (all views, all queries; trend uses two) is re-executed once and each row is read: unknown capability is unassessed; validity_unknown, validity_unspecified, no_adopted_measurement and unresolved_measurement_conflict are needs_information with requests; any other row has a unique candidate in diagnostics.candidate_refs and context requirements are judged per destination
states: element states met, unmet, unrepresentable, unassessed; aggregation unassessed over not_representable over needs_information over satisfied; requests only on needs_information; no inferred information; ai_candidate never satisfies an element

requests.candidate: visible unconfirmed record of confirmed certainty covering the target time whose field is known; origin kind kept; never counted as satisfying

steps: 1 + C + sum over queries of (6 + 8 for line or exchange, 6 + 12 for trend) + 1; C is the full P2-i plan fee and P2-i is called once at budget C and must use exactly C; the P2-f child must use exactly its reservation; fees are prepaid, never refunded
answers: unfinished rows have null selection, elements, requests, output and flows; the certificate is always not_certified; inferred_information is always empty
limitations: diagnostic only; not a certification of preservation or clinical correctness; no destination outside the three output kinds; rounding only half-even; requirement versions are fictional
observer: record and correct operations must carry an observer {kind: human|device, ref} or {kind: unknown}; it is passed to the ledger record unchanged and checked by the temporal measurement child; the library never fills in a missing observer; selection evidence always emits record_observer; confirm operations carry none
